title: Citizens' Climate Lobby

definition.text: Citizens' Climate Lobby is an international grassroots group that trains volunteers to lobby elected representatives on climate policy.

facts.text: It proposes a fee on carbon dioxide and equivalent gases to cut US emissions.
Carbon fee and dividend is its preferred climate solution, and its chapters abroad push for a revenue-neutral version.

related: Energy Innovation and Carbon Dividend Act
notes: Excluded: a single advocacy NGO; useful only as context under Carbon fee and dividend.
